title: M.M.M.
description: A modpack about magic, might, and machinery
body:
A modpack about magic, might, and machinery.
This modpack has many mods that combine into a great big adventure. This modpack includes mods that have guns, airplanes, and more. In this pack, we also have Ars Nouveau and Create, and as you progress, you will have to either find or make modded eyes of ender that can be found across the world.
